correctness.rationale: All points at c=0 satisfy A²B²=-I. From Cayley--Hamilton either a≠0 and B commuting with A² implies B commuting with A, or a=0 forces B=±I. Thus Z=AB is semisimple traceless and A=(aI+bZ)/2, B=(bI+aZ)/2, with a²+b²=4. The reduced zero-trace representation variety is equivariantly the conic times two semisimple traceless orbits, and its GIT quotient is Gm×A1 via a torus-slice computation. For c≠0, the relation cC=I+(A²B²)^-1 gives cs=2p and the other trace recovery identities; the boundary formulas prove them at c=0 as well. The classical rank-three trace-invariant generators, exactness for reductive invariants and pointwise identities make a,b,c,s generate the full reduced invariant ring. The explicit companion matrices and Cayley--Hamilton square root realize every point of the claimed hypersurface with c≠0, proving no extra relation; irreducibility follows from primitivity and linearity in s. Its partial derivatives have no common zero. The extracted symbolic checker established exact algebra identities and Jacobian unit ideal, while the full proof covers arbitrary complex parameters. The formula makes no unreduced-scheme assertion.
